name: 1. Purchase and Sale
text: 1. Purchase and Sale. Subject to the terms and conditions hereof, Seller agrees to sell to Buyer, and Buyer agrees to purchase from Seller, fee simple title ownership to that certain parcel! of real estate located at 1200 6” Street, Detroit, Michigan containing approximately 10.89 acres, which is legally described in Exhibit A attached hereto and made apart hereof, together with all improvements, buildings, structures, and attached fixtures located thereon, including any and ail rights, privileges, easements and appurtenances, if any, thereunto belonging (“Property”). The Property shall be sold and conveyed together with all right, title, and interest, if any, of Seller in and to any land lying in the bed of any street, road, or avenue opened or proposed, in front of or adjoining the Property, to the center line thereof, and all right, title, and interest of the Seller in and to any award made or to be made in lieu thereof and in and to any unpaid award for damage to the Property by reason of change of grade of any street; and the Seller will execute and deliver to the Buyer, on closing of title, or thereafter, on demand, all proper instruments for the conveyance of such title and the assignment and collection of any such award.

name: 2. Purchase Price
text: 2. Purchase Price. The total purchase price for the Property shall be $9,000,000 (Nine Million Dollars). At Closing, the sum of $8,000,000 (Eight Million Dollars) shall be due and payable to the Seller plus or minus any standard deductions and prorations (customary closing expenses incurred by the Seller inclusive of utility and real estate tax prorations). The remaining balance less any deductions identified below shall be paid to the Seller at a rate of 10% of the annual tax incremental financing reimbursement received by Buyer, For example, the anticipated annual Tax Incremental Financing [TIF] amount is approximately $2,000,000 of which an estimated $200,000 shall be paid to 1200 6"" Street, LLC, annually, and shall become due and payable within thirty (30) days of receipt of same until the remaining $1,000,000 (One Million Dollars) (or less dependent upon setoffs as described below) are received (“Outstanding Balance”). The Outstanding Balance shall accrue interest to the same extent, if any, that either or both the City of Detroit or the State of Michigan pay interest to the Buyer on the outstanding incurred eligible expenses and which shall be paid to Seller. In the event the sale is consummated, and subject to repayment of the Outstanding Balance owed to 1200 6™ Street, LLC (less any deductions) the tax incremental reimbursement shall belong to the Buyer.

name: 3. Deed
text: 3. Deed. The Seller, at the time of closing of title, shall execute and deliver to the Buyer, a warranty deed containing the new legal descriptions which reflect the City of Detroit’s final approved plat of vacation and dedication of right of way necessary to affect the Buyer’s desired street closures, and the contiguous properties created as a result of vacating Sixth Street and Abbott Street, in customary form, consistent with statutory requirements, conveying good and marketable indefeasible fee simple title to the Property free from any and all liens or encumbrances, subject only to those items identified in the Real Estate Option Agreement dated between 1200 Sixth Street, LLC and GSA as permitted exceptions ("Permitted Exceptions").

name: 4. Title
text: 4. Title. No Later than thirty (30) days following the date of this Agreement and prior to closing, Seller shall deliver to buyer a final commitment ("Title Commitment"), for a standard ALTA Form B owner's policy of title insurance on the Property issued by Chicago Title Insurance Company, the office in ("Title Company") at Sellers sole cost and expanse. If the Title Commitment discloses exceptions to title other than those Permitted Exceptions attached hereto or otherwise approved by Buyer in writing, then Seller, at Seller's sole expense, shall have ten (10) business days prior to the date of Closing, to have such unpermitted exceptions removed from title or to cause the Title Company to commit to issue an endorsement insuring Buyer against loss or damage to Buyer that may be caused by such unpermitted exceptions. If Seller is unable to have such unpermitted exceptions removed from the Title Commitment or endorsed over, Buyer may elect, prior to the expiration of the period for Seller to remedy such unpermitted exceptions, to either (a) terminate this Agreement by written notice to Seller or (b) accept title to the Property subject to the Permitted Exceptions and such unpermitted exceptions which shall then be deemed to be Permitted Exceptions. On the date of closing of title, the Title Company shall issue an owner's title insurance policy or title commitment therefore, pursuant to and in accordance with the Title Commitment in the amount of the Purchase. Price insuring the fee simple title to the Property in the Buyer as of the date of closing of title, subject only to the Permitted Exceptions.

name: 5. Survey
text: 5, Survey. Provided this agreement shall have been executed by Seller and Buyer, Seller will deliver to Buyer, an updated final plat of survey of the Property which shall reflect the City of Detroit’s final approved plat of vacation and dedication of right of way, describing the immediate contiguous properties created as a result of vacating Sixth Street and Abbott Street, as a prepared in accordance with the 2005 ALTA standards and certified as such to the Buyer, its lender, and the Title Company.

name: 6. Condition of Property
text: 6, Condition of Property. Buyer acknowledges that prior to the date of this Agreement, Buyer has had the opportunity to make a complete and independent investigation of all facts and data which Buyer deems necessary in its decisions to acquire the Property, including, without limitation, all the facts and data pertaining to environmental conditions at, in, or, under, or affecting the Property and does hereby accept the Property subject to all federal, state, county, and municipal laws, requirements, rules, orders, ordinances, regulations relating, in any manner, thereto. Buyer further acknowledges that it has inspected the Property or caused an inspection to be made thereof on Buyer's behalf and is familiar with the physical condition thereof except as expressly set forth elsewhere in the Agreement. Buyer agrees to accept the Property in the condition existing on the date of closing of title, including all faults of every kind and nature whatsoever whether latent or patent and whether now or hereafter existing.

name: 7. Seller's Representations — introduction and closing warranty
text: 7. seller's Representations. Seller covenants and represents to Buyer:

name: 7(a) Record owner and authority
text: (a) Seller is the record owner of the Property and has the requisite power and authority to enter into and fully carry out this Agreement and the sale of the Property contemplated herein.

name: 7(b) No knowledge of title or development impediments
text: (b) It has no knowledge of any teason why the local governmental authorities would not allow the Property to be developed for the Federal Office facilities contemplated herein; that possession of the land has been peaceable and undisturbed; that Seller's title to the Property has never been disputed or questioned to its knowledge; nor does Seller know of any facts by reason of which said possession or title might be disturbed or questioned, or by reason of which any claim to the Property, or any part thereof might arise or be set up adverse to Seller.

name: 7(c) Utilities
text: (c) Electricity, telephone, sewer, and water utilities have been installed within the adjacent public right of ways and are of sufficient size, capacity and are available for immediate connection at the Property without any special charge, assessment or apparatus for its current use.

name: 7(d) Environmental disclosure
text: (d) Seller has disclosed that the property is a “facility” as defined by MCL 324.20101 et seq. due to the property's historic uses described in the environmental reports Seller provided to Buyer. Seller also represents that it has provided all environmental information that it has with respect to the environmental condition of the Property including the existence of asbestos containing materials located in existing structures.

name: 7(e) Environmental representations to best of knowledge
text: (e) Except as otherwise indicated on Schedule A attached, or as described in paragraph 7 (d) of this agreement, to the best of Seller’s actual knowledge: (1) — that since Seller acquired an interest in the property, Seller has been in compliance with all federal, state and local laws, rules, regulations, ordinances, codes and orders governing, establishing, limiting or otherwise affecting the discharge or disposal of hazardous substances or hazardous waste; (2) that the property has not been used since the time Seller acquired any interest in the property for storage, disposal, deposit, treatment, or recycling of toxic, dangerous or hazardous substances; (3) that in the event that any subsequent purchaser of the property avails itself of the available statutory exemptions from environmental liability, there are no activities on the property which would subject an owner thereof to damages, penalties, injunctive relief or clean-up costs under any federal, state or local law or under any civil action respecting hazardous substances on the property. The exemptions include that owner’s obligations to comply with its due care requirements as stated in MCL 324.20107a, its obtaining a Baseline Environmental Site Assessment under MCL 324.20101 et seq. and compliance with the All Appropriate Inquiry exemption as defined and in CERCLA, as amended.

name: 7 Continuing truth of representations
text: Seller represents and warrants to the Buyer that the above representations are true and correct as of the date hereof and will continue to be true and correct on each day hereafter.

name: 8(a) Closing and Obligations at Closing
text: 8. Closing and Obligations at Closing. (a) Subject to any termination of this Agreement permitted hereunder by Buyer or Seller, closing ("Closing") shall take place at the office of the Title Company on a mutually agreeable date, but, in no event later than ninety (90) days after the execution of this Agreement. At Closing, the obligations of Buyer and Seller shall be as follows: (i) (ii) (iii) (iv) Buyer shall cause the Purchase Price, plus or minus prorations, to be paid to Seller as provided for in Section 2.

name: 8(a)(ii) Warranty Deed
text: Seller shall execute and deliver a recordable Warranty Deed as provided for in Section 3, conveying title to the Property to Buyer, subject to the Permitted Exceptions, and any exceptions created or suffered by Buyer.

name: 8(a)(iii) Transferor's certification
text: Seller shall execute a transferor's certification stating that Seller is not: a "foreign person", a "foreign partnership", "foreign trust", or "foreign estate” as those terms are defined in Section 1445 of the Internal Revenue code, and containing such additional information as may be required thereunder;

name: 8(a)(iv) Other documentation
text: Seller and Buyer shall] execute such other documentation as is required by applicable law to effectuate the transaction contemplated hereby, and such other documentation as is reasonably required by the Title Company to issue the title policy(ies) in accordance with Section 4 hereof, including, without limitation, ALTA statements and GAP undertakings, if required the Title Company. This Section 8(a)(v) shall not require Buyer or Seller to incur any extraordinary obligations at the request of the Title Company.

name: 8(a)(v) Possession
text: (v) Possession of the Property shall be delivered to Buyer.

name: 8(b) Escrow closing
text: (b) At the request of either party, the transaction contemplated hereby shall be closed in escrow, with the concurrent delivery of the documents of title, transfer of interests, delivery of the Title Policy and the payment of the Purchase Price. Buyer and Seller shall each provide undertakings to the Title Company necessary for the Closing in escrow to occur. Seller and Buyer shall each pay 50% of any Closing escrow fees and the charges of the Title Company for such closing.

name: 9. Prorations
text: 9, Prorations. All real estate taxes, expenses and charges in connection with ownership and use of the Property shall be prorated at Closing. To the extent that information for any such proration is not available at Closing Date, the parties shall effect such prorations within thirty (30) days after such information is available.

name: 10. Default
text: 10. Default. If Seller fails or refuses to comply with the terms of this Agreement within five (5) days of receipt by Seller of written notice of such default, for any reason other than Buyer's default hereunder, Buyer may (a) sue Seller for the specific performance of this Agreement if such suit for specific performance is commenced within ninety (90) days after the date of Seller's failure or refusal to comply with the terms of this Agreement, or (b) may sue Seller for actual damages. If Buyer fails or refuses to comply with the terms of this Agreement within five (5) days of receipt by Buyer of written notice of such default for any reason other than Seller's default hereunder; Seller is entitled to, as liquidated damages not to exceed $50,000, either a $50,000 fetter of credit or cash equivalent (at Buyer’s option) which the Buyer is required to obtain or place in escrow, upon the execution of this Agreement and within ten (10) business days of Award and Assignment of the Option to Purchase. In the event the Assignment to the Buyer is revoked by the United States of America, acting by and through the U.S. General Services Administration, the Buyer is entitled to the $50,000 letter of credit or cash equivalent. Any subsequent Buyer is required to obtain, a $50,000 letter of credit or cash equivalent (at Buyer’s option) upon the execution of this Agreement and within ten (10) business days of Award and Assignment of the Option to Purchase. In addition, the parties may seek any other remedy available at law or in equity.

name: 11. Risk of Loss
text: 11. Risk of Loss. The risk of loss or damage to the Property, if any, including but not limited to the buildings and other improvements; if any, by fire, the elements, or otherwise until the delivery of the deed hereunder is assumed by the Seller. In case the property shall suffer injury beyond the ordinary wear and tear, the Seller shall repair the damage before the date set for delivery of the deed or make an appropriate deduction from the purchase price provided in Section 2.

name: 12. Condemnation
text: 12. Condemnation. In the event of any taking by the exercise of the power of eminent domain of a substantial portion of the Property prior to Closing (such portion as would impair or otherwise affect the intended use of the Real Property will be deemed substantial). Buyer shall have the right to terminate this Agreement by giving written notice to Seller within ten (10) days after receipt by Buyer of written notification of any such condemnation. If Buyer elects to terminate this Agreement, all awards and compensation arising out of said condemnation shall be the property of Seller. If Buyer fails to give Seller written notice of termination within said ten (10) day period, said right to terminate shall be deemed waived and Buyer shall be credited with or assigned all of Seller's right, title and interest to all awards and compensation arising out of said condemnation, and Buyer shall remain obligated to purchase the Property with no reduction in the Purchase Price. In the event of any taking of an insubstantial portion of the Property prior to the Closing Date (such portion as would not impair or otherwise affect the intended use of the Property will be deemed insubstantial), Seller shall assign to Buyer all of Seller's right, title and interest to all awards and compensation therefore and Buyer shall remain obligated to purchase the Property with no reduction in the Purchase Price.

name: 13. Buyer's Right to Enter and Inspect the Property
text: 13. Buyer's Right to Enter and Inspect the Property The Buyer's authorized or ' designated representatives or agents, or offerors participating in the lease procurement process of the Buyer, shall have the right during the period of this Option including any extension periods subject to the rights, interests, and uses made of the Property by the Seller, to enter upon the Property for the purpose of inspecting same and making test borings, plans, topographical and boundary Surveys, environmental assessments, and any other due diligence matters deemed reasonably prudent in connection with the contemplated use of the Property as a leasehold for Federal facilities. Optionee shall require any of said parties to maintain insurance in amounts and coverages reasonably acceptable to Optionor. Said parties shall promptly repair and restore the Property to the same condition as existed immediately prior to such entry if such entry resulted in any damage thereto. Optionee shall provide Optionor reasonable notice prior to entering the Property.

name: 14. Notices
text: 14, Notices. All notices or communications required under this Agreement or which either party desires to give to the other shall be sent by either (i) certified or registered United States mail, return receipt requested, postage prepaid; or (ii) personal delivery; or (iii) by recognized, private, overnight courier, with evidence of delivery, and shall be addressed to the parties as follows: If to Seller: Mr. Sam Danou 1200 6" Street LLC 16630 Southfield Road Allen Park, MI 48101 With copy to: Mr. Forrest Hudson U.S. General Services Administration Office of Property Development 230 S. Dearborn Street, Room 3600 Chicago, IL 60604 If to Buyer: Notices shall be deemed to have been received on the second (2"°) business day after they are deposited in the- United States mail as provided above and one (1) business day after deposit with a recognized, private overnight courier as provided above.

name: 15. Brokerage
text: 15. Brokerage. Each party hereby represents and warrants to the other that no commission or other amount is payable to any other person or entity for brokerage or similar services performed hereunder.

name: 16. Other Acts
text: 16, Other Acts. Buyer and Seller each hereby agree to perform such other acts, and to execute, acknowledge, and/or deliver such other instruments, documents, and materials, as may be reasonably necessary to effect consummation of the transaction contemplated herein.

name: 17. Time is of the Essence
text: 17. Time is of the Essence. Buyer and Seller mutually agree that time is of the essence throughout the term of this Agreement and every provision hereof in which time is an element. No extension of time for performance of any obligations or acts shall be deemed an extension of time for performance of any other obligations or acts. If any date for performance of any of the terms, conditions, or provisions hereof shall fall on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday, then the time of such performance shall be extended to the next business day thereafter.

name: 18. Paragraph or Section Headings
text: 18. Paragraph or Section Headings. The paragraph headings contained in this Agreement are for convenience only and shall in no way enlarge or limit the scope or meaning of the various and several paragraphs hereof.

name: 19. Interpretation
text: 19. Interpretation. Whenever used in this Agreement, the singular number shall include the plural, the plural the singular, and the use of any gender shall include all genders.

name: 20. Applicable Law and Parties Bound
text: 20. Applicable Law and Parties Bound. This Agreement shall be construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the state in which the Property is located and shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties hereto and their respective heirs, legal representatives, successors and permitted assigns.

name: 21. Attorney's Fees
text: 21. Attorney's Fees. In the event either party elects to file any action in order to enforce the terms of this Agreement, or for a declaration of rights hereunder, the prevailing party, as determined by the court in such action, shall be entitled to recover all of its court costs and reasonable attorneys' fees as a result thereof from the losing party.

name: 22. Amendments
text: 22. Amendments. All amendments and/or supplements to this Agreement must be in writing and executed by each party hereto. However, such amendments and/or supplements may be executed in counterparts, all of which shall be deemed to constitute one document.

name: 23. No Merger
text: 23. No Merger. The parties agree that the obligations, representations and warranties herein contained shall not merge with transfer of title but shall survive the Closing and remain in effect until fulfilled, up to and including the time of completion of any improvements to be built thereon and the written acceptance of occupancy of such improvements by the United States of America General services Administration through its designated agent.

name: 24. Prior Agreements
text: 24. Prior Agreements. The parties agree and acknowledge that this Agreement cancels and supersedes all prior agreements, whether written, oral, or both; is entire in itself; and that this Agreement, and that certain Real Estate Option Agreement dated , August, 2006, by and between the United States of America (“Government”) acting by the U.S. General Services Administration (“GSA”) and the Seller-which has been assigned to the Buyer hereunder ("Option ), are the only agreements between parties hereto respecting the Property and its terms of sale; that all agreements and undertakings between the parties are embodied in the Agreement and the Option. No promises, covenants, or representations of any kind, other than those expressly contained herein, have been made to induce any party hereto to enter into this Agreement. This Agreement may be amended only by written instrument, executed by the Buyer, Seller and the Government, acting by GSA, its designated agent.

name: 25. No Recording
text: 25. No Recording. Buyer shall not record this Agreement or any memorandum or short form hereof.

name: 26. Utilities/Utilities Relocations and Costs
text: 26. Utilities/Utilities Relocations and Costs. Gas, electricity, telephone, sewer, and water utilities have been installed within the adjacent public right of ways and are of sufficient size, capacity and are available for immediate connection at the Property without any special charge, assessment or apparatus. All public and quasi-public and private utilities terminations, and relocations are the sole responsibility of Buyer, and Buyer shall assume all costs associated therewith after 8 closing.

name: 27. Counterparts
text: 27 Counterparts. This agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, any one of which shall be considered an original; and all of which, taken together shall be deemed to be one original.

name: 28. Tax Incentive Financing
text: 28. Tax Incentive Financing. The Seller will cooperate with the Buyer to secure all necessary government approvals for an approved Brownfield Plan and any other applicable grant and/or loan programs. In the event the sale is consummated, and subject to repayment of the Outstanding Balance owed to 1200 6" Street, LLC (less any setoff) the tax incremental reimbursement shall belong to the Buyer.
